name: What actually happens during garage drywall installation?

mainEntity.name: What actually happens during garage drywall installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process usually starts with measuring, checking the wall or ceiling structure, and confirming whether any insulation, vapor control, or fire-rating requirements apply. After that, the crew hangs the boards, tapes the seams, applies mud, sands the surface, and finishes it for paint or texture.
acceptedAnswer.description: It usually includes measuring, hanging panels, taping seams, mudding, sanding, and finishing. For attached garages, fire-rating requirements are checked before installation starts.
